corrections.text: The article states a further $2 million was moved out of exposed wallets "around June 30." The cited Cointelegraph article instead reports that this $2 million was moved "on Sunday," which corresponds to July 5, 2026 given the article's July 6, 2026 (Monday) publish date and its own references to Coinspect's disclosure occurring on Sunday and SlowMist posting about it on Monday. The $5 million aggregate total and the May 27 exploitation start date are correctly sourced; only the date of the second $2 million movement is wrong.
